newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lockheed Martin to buy RD Amross rocket engines.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin to buy RD Amross rocket engines.

text.p: Lockheed Martin said on Tuesday it is buying up to 101 new RD-180 rocket engines from Russian-U.S. joint venture RD Amross LLC. The total value of the agreement is expected to be one billion dollars.

Lockheed Martin has set up an international teaming relationship with the RD Amross joint venture that was formed by NTO Energomash and Pratt and Whitney, an operating unit of United Technologies Corp, to co-produce the RD 180 engines under exclusive contract for Lockheed Martin.

The 101 engines covered by the deal will be used for Lockheed Martin's new Atlas 2AR launch vehicle and the commercial missions for the company's candidate for the U.S. Air Force's Evolved Expendable Launch Vehicle (EELV) family of rockets.
NTO Energomash will build the engines in Khimky, Russia for use on the commercial launches.

"This all relates to commercial space. We are committed to increased reliability and minimum risk for our new launchers," Mel Brashears, President of Lockheed Martin Space and Strategic Missiles Sector, told a news conference.
